sections.Profile:
"Stage Coach" is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Co. in 1968.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Western, Original Theme
